headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with AI‑driven firms posting strong top‑line gains while legacy players saw modest revenue and profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI revenue contributed materially for several firms, boosting margins at HCLTech and TCS. Profit growth was mixed, with HCLTech and Coforge posting double‑digit jumps, whereas Infosys and Wipro saw only modest or negative changes. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge and Mphasis.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue expansion
themes.detail: AI revenue grew 29% at Infosys, 47% at LTM and $219 m at HCLTech, underpinning profit and margin improvements.

themes.title: Margin and guidance shifts
themes.detail: Coforge raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%; Infosys cut revenue growth guidance to 1‑2%; HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 guidance.

themes.title: Profit variability
themes.detail: Net profit rose 21% at HCLTech and 56% at Coforge, but fell 1.9% at Wipro and only grew 6% at Infosys.
